headline: Wardens Retake Ground on Nevish Line; Colonials Sweep Marban Hollow
war_summary: Warden arms have recovered ground on the Nevish Line since the previous edition, that sector now standing seven Warden works against one Colonial, though five actions were logged in the last two hours about Blackcoat Way, Grief Mother and Princefal and some seventy across the day. Marban Hollow has swung the other way: Colonial forces now hold six works to one Warden, with one unclaimed, and four actions in two hours around Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall. Linn Mercy's last Warden work has been erased, leaving ten Colonial and one unclaimed, and its hourly casualty counts have fallen well below the previous day's pace at Lathair. In Weathered Expanse the lone Colonial work has likewise gone, leaving seven Warden and two unclaimed; the guns there have warmed again, four actions in two hours and forty-eight in the day about Crow's Nest, Wightwalk and Spirit Watch. Kuura Strand remains silent since the previous evening, five Colonial works and one unclaimed. Heavy bloodshed without a change of colours continues in the Dead Lands, Callahan's Passage, Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle, where hourly casualty rates are climbing.
